workflows.notes: 2026-05-13: Promoted clean OpenPose + masked IPAdapter route from 00 sandbox. Failed/weak variants (PuLID combo, Depth-only, Canny-only, dirty prompt, DWPreprocessor, pose-reference VAE img2img latent) are not canonical. Clean Danbooru prompt excludes dark_background/depth_of_field/volumetric_lighting and negatives ban dark/vignette/dramatic lighting. Multi-pose smoke passed silver_bob arms_crossed/hand_chest stable and pointing/one_hand_hip caution. Second-character smoke passed pink_twinbraids arms_crossed/hand_chest stable and pointing caution. 02 alpha gate passed for silver/pink arms_crossed and hand_chest. Same-seed background sweep selected positive `grey_background` only; avoid `simple_background`, `flat_background`, and `dark_background` in 04 positive prompt. 2026-05-13 no-rim retest: remove `thick_outline`; it caused sticker-like white exterior rim in 04 source, which 02 alpha preserved. Stable arms_crossed/hand_chest 04→02 retest passed with no `thick_outline`; keep 03 expression-strength as separate unresolved gate. 2026-05-13 cleanup: legacy text-only and old IPAdapter JSONs moved to 00_experiment_sandbox/workflow_api/legacy_04_pose_precanonical_2026-05-13; numbered 04 folder now keeps one active canonical workflow JSON.
